name: XTC New Energy Materials(Xiamen) Co.,Ltd.
summary: XTC New Energy Materials(Xiamen) Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of lithium-ion battery cathode materials in China. The company offers high-voltage NCM materials, lithium cobalt oxide, high nickel NCM materials, lithium iron phosphate, sodium ion battery materials, and hydrogen storage materials for use in 3C consumer electronics, power battery, energy storage, and hydrogen energy markets. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Xiamen, China. XTC New Energy Materials(Xiamen) Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Xiamen Tungsten Co.,Ltd.
